name: protean
description: Lease-bound sandbox runner: HMAC-SHA256 leases with TTL, risk-routed substrates (bubblewrap, Docker runc, Docker + seccomp, optional remote gVisor) and JSONL evidence. The lease is an internal consistency/evidence receipt, not caller authorization.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a command inside a lease-bound sandbox. risk=low -> bubblewrap with a minimal read-only root and 32 MiB /tmp; medium -> Docker runc (--network=none, cap-drop ALL, read-only, tmpfs /tmp); high -> Docker + seccomp allowlist (or gVisor if available); critical -> denied locally unless remote=true and a remote host is configured. Only the first executable token is checked; shell syntax can run other binaries inside the sandbox. Unknown risk/substrate, invalid or expired lease, TTL overflow, net=true for medium/high/critical, and executables outside the allowlist are denied (fail-closed). Returns rc, clipped stdout/stderr, ms, substrate, genome_hash, lease_id, out_sha256 and evidence path.

cmd.description: Command to execute inside the sandbox (1..4096 chars, no NUL). Only the first executable token is checked against the allowlist.

risk.description: Risk class selects the substrate. critical requires remote=true plus a configured remote host.

net.description: Allow network. Default false. Only risk=low supports net=true; medium/high/critical are network-isolated.

timeout_s.description: Execution timeout in seconds (default 20). Lease TTL is derived from it and verified before execution.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the sandbox (default /tmp). Must not contain ..; the directory must exist in the sandbox.

remote.description: Only for risk=critical: run on the configured remote host over SSH with gVisor. Denied for lower risks.
